text:
incident-bot: paging @oncall — ALERT: realtime-p99-detector fired for /v1/stream at 2024-06-12T14:37:02Z (p99 2.8s, baseline 420ms). SLO breach detected for the past 6m. Auto-notes: sample rate 1%. Logs aggregated to /alerts/1719992222
Alice Chen: ack. I'm on it. taking pager.
Samir Patel: I can help — grabbing grafana + logs now. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/latency?orgId=1&from=now-30m
Priya Singh: FYI we've had a small spike on the kvcache evictions earlier but didn't correlate yet.
Alice Chen: quick check list: 1) which routes impacted 2) any errors vs timeouts 3) infra metrics (cpu/gpu, net retries) 4) model fallback behavior
Mateo Rivera: I'm watching LB errors — seeing 502 spikes from the proxy for a subset of requests to the stream cluster.
Samir Patel: copying charts: p95 jumped to 740ms, p99 to 2.8s. error ratio 0.6% -> 1.9% in last 5m. streaming stall rate up ~3x.
Alice Chen: can someone run a quick tail on streamer logs for 14:30-14:38? use: `k logs -l app=streamer -n prod --since=10m | grep -i "stall\|timeout\|kv cache"`
Priya Singh: ran that, seeing repeated `kvcache: miss` logs stamped 14:34:11 then `retry_loop timeout` at 14:34:12 clustered on a few pods.
Samir Patel: also seeing increased redis latency around same time — tail from redis-prod shows occasional 200-400ms spikes.
Mateo Rivera: proxy logs show `upstream_read_timeout` for pods on node g4-x-12a. Node telemetry: CPU 70%, GPU fine, network rx spikes on eth0.
Alice Chen: hypothesis: transient kvcache/redis degradation caused higher upstream latency which cascaded into stream stalls and p99 spikes.
incident-bot: NOTE: affected customers flagged: high-traffic streaming tenants (tenant ids masked) — potential customer impact: degraded interactive experiences, timeouts > 5s for <1% of requests.
Priya Singh: mitigation propose: 1) enable model-fallback to small-quantized variant for the stream pool 2) increase kvcache replication factor for short window 3) scale streamer pods by +30% and cordon problematic node
Samir Patel: I'm applying scaleup now: `kubectl scale deployment streamer --replicas=26 -n prod` (was 20). Will monitor.
Mateo Rivera: cordoning node g4-x-12a and draining pods from it: `kubectl cordon g4-x-12a && kubectl drain g4-x-12a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — starting.
Alice Chen: enabling fallback model route for the stream gateway (temporary flag): `SET route.stream.use_fallback=true --env=prod` — doing a canary first on 5%.
Samir Patel: canary looks good so far, p99 back to 1.1s on canary traffic.
Alice Chen: rolling to 50% now.
Priya Singh: adding a short-term cache bypass to avoid kvcache hot path: toggle `kvcache.read_path=prefer_local` off; forcing direct redis reads as a test.
Mateo Rivera: redis team notified; they confirm backend maintenance earlier caused higher tail latencies starting ~14:33 (overlapping window). They're rolling a fix.
incident-bot: Severity adjusted to P2 (was P1) — automated note: paging reclassified because mitigation in progress and majority of traffic stable.
Samir Patel: after rollout to 50% p99 trending 580-700ms; errors dropping back toward baseline. streaming stalls reduced.
Alice Chen: customer impact estimate: ~0.5% of requests experienced >3s delay, small set of enterprise customers may have seen degraded UX for up to ~8 minutes. No known data loss.
Priya Singh: logs show a small spike in KV write latency too; will follow up with infra postmortem for kvcache tuning + redis read replicas.
Mateo Rivera: confirm drain done, problematic node out of rotation. New pods on different nodes.
Samir Patel: monitoring for 15m to ensure stable. setting alert cooldown.
Alice Chen: starting incident writeup skeleton in ops-runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/incidents/1719992222 (will fill details)
incident-bot: action items: @Samir follow monitoring for 30m; @Priya own retro for kvcache; @Mateo validate node hardware/network telemetry; @Alice coordinate customer comms if needed.
Alice Chen: handing off to eng-oncall for post-mitigation watch. I'm unassigning pager in 10m. If regression occurs, re-page immediately.
Samir Patel: noted — will keep an eye. tagging oncall-bot to set a 30m watch reminder.
oncall-bot: Reminder set for 30 minutes for thread 1719992222. Good luck :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: quick note for postmortem: include circuit-breaker thresholds, kvcache eviction heuristics, and redis SLA alignment.
Mateo Rivera: ETA for full rollback of temporary flags ~2h after stabilization.
Alice Chen: thanks team. I'm marking the thread as mitigated for now, leaving monitoring tasks open. will update when we close.
Samir Patel: update @ 14:52 UTC — metrics stable, p99 ~480ms, no new 502 bursts. closing alert in 10m if stable.
Alice Chen: last check 14:58 — closing incident channel if no regressions. Great work.
